requirements.quote:
This could result in a version of TLS newer than 1.3 being
   negotiated if both endpoints support that version.
requirements.condition: When negotiating a TLS version newer than 1.3 for a QUIC connection.
requirements.required_behavior: Ensure that both endpoints support the negotiated newer TLS version.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not negotiate a newer TLS version that either endpoint does not support.
requirements.why_checkable: A negotiation test can control the versions supported by each endpoint and verify that a newer version is selected only from their common support.

requirements.quote:
This is
   acceptable provided that the features of TLS 1.3 that are used by
   QUIC are supported by the newer version.
requirements.condition: When using a TLS version newer than 1.3 with QUIC.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a newer version that supports every TLS 1.3 feature on which QUIC relies.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a newer TLS version with QUIC if it lacks a TLS 1.3 feature used by QUIC.
requirements.why_checkable: The negotiated version's supported feature set can be compared with the TLS 1.3 features exercised by the QUIC integration.

requirements.quote: Clients MUST NOT offer TLS versions older than 1.3.
requirements.condition: When a QUIC client offers TLS versions during negotiation.
requirements.required_behavior: Offer only TLS 1.3 or newer versions.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not offer TLS 1.2 or any TLS version older than 1.3.
requirements.why_checkable: The client's offered TLS version list can be decoded and checked for any value older than TLS 1.3.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST terminate the connection if a
   version of TLS older than 1.3 is negotiated.
requirements.condition: If an endpoint negotiates a TLS version older than 1.3.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue the connection using the negotiated older TLS version.
requirements.error_behavior: Terminate the QUIC connection upon detecting that the negotiated TLS version is older than 1.3.
requirements.why_checkable: A peer can force or simulate negotiation of an older version and verify that the endpoint terminates rather than proceeds.
